title: TSE Accepts Flávio Bolsonaro's Complaint Against Lula and Alckmin Over Samba Parade
detail: Brazil's Supreme Electoral Court (TSE) accepted a complaint filed by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro against President Lula and Vice President Geraldo Alckmin over their participation in a samba school parade, a politically charged move ahead of the 2026 elections. The case raises questions about the use of public office for electoral advantage.
